description: Elevated Tempertaure Properties of ASTM A992 Steel is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Michael Engelhardt, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This project collected test data on the elevated temperature properties of ASTM A992 steel. This data is intended to support development of performance-based structural fire engineering for steel structures. A detailed description of the test setup, test specimens, instrumentation, and data reduction techniques is available in the Ph.D. dissertation by Lee listed under Related Work. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Fire, steel, elevated temperature, stress-strain curves. Published 2021-02-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
